visual_identity.description: Antagonist Dạ Vô Nhai (Hắc Y Kiếm Tu): formidable, brooding martial cultivator whose presence exerts crushing spatial gravity, wielding a massive broadsword with devastating kinetic momentum.
visual_identity.face_geometry: Angular chiselled jawline with prominent cheekbones, deep-set hooded piercing eyes with intense focused gaze, firm cleft chin, brooding stern expression forged in fierce combat.
visual_identity.body_proportions: Broad, muscular athletic frame, approximately 185cm height, wide shoulders, thick forearms, low and grounded center of gravity with powerful rooted leg stance.
visual_identity.hair: Coarse dark raven hair, shoulder-length; crown and temple strands drawn back into a half-ponytail clamped with a hammered obsidian-iron clasp, loose rogue strands whipping across temples in heavy mountain wind.
visual_identity.skin: Weathered pale olive skin tone, hardened texture with faint shadow under hollow cheeks, reflecting cold diffused mountain ambient light.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad-shouldered, wedge-shaped and heavily grounded; asymmetrical silhouette reinforced by right-shoulder leather pauldron and heavy trailing dark coat tails.
unique_traits: Piercing, predatory eye contact locked onto opponent weapon hand
Heavy single-pauldron leather armor contouring right shoulder
Visible muscle tension in neck and traps during heavy downward swings

baseline: Initiates combat through relentless forward pressure and spatial encroachment
Delivers heavy cleaving arcs with devastating momentum and grounded weight-transfer
Employs dark qi compression barrier (X06) to nullify incoming thrusts and reposition
Maintains grim combat dignity; accepts defeat silently on one knee (X11) after sword barrier shatters
Rhythmic, deliberate foot stomps that transfer kinetic force directly from stone pavers into blade swings
forbidden: No comedic villain smirks, maniacal laughter, or cartoonish scowls
No cowardly flinching or frantic scrambling on the ground
No glowing demonic eyes, horns, or beast transformations
No flashy wire-fu acrobatics or unnecessary mid-air spinning kicks
No verbal taunting or breaking disciplined martial focus

look_states.description: Charcoal-Black Layered Combat Robes (Huyền Sắc Võ Bào) with armor reinforcement for high-altitude duel.
look_states.wardrobe: Heavy-duty martial combat attire: inner charcoal twill undertunic, middle matte black linen coat with reinforced hem, outer layered midnight-black heavy wool-silk robe with weathered edges; sculpted matte-black boiled leather pauldron on right shoulder secured by aged bronze rivets and cross-chest harness; dual reinforced black leather vambraces with bronze stud accents; wide leather sash with double iron buckle; heavy iron-shod black combat boots with reinforced shins.
look_states.hair: Half-tied raven hair bound with dark iron hair-ring, rest falling freely past shoulders and blowing aggressively across collar.
look_states.makeup: Grounded cinematic realism: weathered matte finish, sharp facial contouring, subtle dark shading around eyes, wind-chapped lips.
accessories: Single-shoulder boiled leather pauldron with dark bronze rivets

Huyền Minh (Trảm Đoán Kiếm): 105cm heavy double-edged broadsword (14cm wide blade) forged from dark meteoric steel with blood fuller, wrapped in stingray skin hilt with heavy iron counterweight pommel
condition: Weathered and travel-tested; matte finish without glossy reflection
Faint dust abrasion on boots and lower coat hem from aggressive lunges and sudden stops on granite
